packageRules.description: Keep the pyproject and pre-commit copies of ruff in lockstep
Keep the package.json and pre-commit copies of prettier in lockstep

Auto-merge non-major updates of linters that CI actually runs, once CI is green. Branch automerge: Renovate pushes the branch, waits for CI and merges it without opening a PR, so there is no notification; a PR is only opened if CI fails. pylint is excluded because CI runs it with --exit-zero. prettier-plugin-jinja-template is excluded because templates are prettier-ignored, so CI never loads it.
